name: discovery-transcriber-v2
description: ASR-based full-length audio/video transcription for Triad Legal, PLLC. Crawls a Google Drive folder, transcribes every file via a dedicated ASR (Speechmatics/Deepgram), adds periodic Gemini scene descriptions for video, assigns real speaker names with Claude, and writes one verbatim Google Doc per file into a 'Video/Audio Transcripts' subfolder.

scripts.check: for f in server.js lib/*.js lib/transcribe/*.js lib/asr/*.js lib/visual/*.js lib/refine/*.js lib/pipeline/*.js jobs/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo 'all files OK'
